# BluePlay reference fixture

Unmodified files from tomkarp/BluePlay's BlueJ project at GitHub commit
`c8ace580f0506571fc34f287280a3e04eba7c876`, downloaded 30 September 2026.
`API.md` is that project's `docs/README.md`. License: included MIT license.

These files are an independent external test reference. Do not regenerate
from BlueK's implementation. Three student files run unchanged against the
built-in library; framework files supply the independent signature comparison.
